license_note: The gated model card links the Gemma Terms of Use, whose appendix lists Gemma 2 and which incorporate the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy by reference. The terms require passing the use restrictions to every redistributor and reserve Google's right to restrict usage it believes violates them, so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Gemma 2 27B IT weights and tokenizer, with Gemma 2 named in the terms appendix
Restricted-use policy incorporated by reference into the Gemma Terms of Use

access_boundary: This record represents the google/gemma-2-27b-it release (initial Gemma 2 launch of June 27, 2024) at Hugging Face commit aaf20e6b9f4c0fcf043f6fb2a2068419086d77b0. The 27B pre-trained model, the 9B and 2B Gemma 2 sizes, Gemma 2 JPN, the Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 generations, quantizations, fine-tunes, and independent serving providers are separate boundaries.
strengths: Google publishes Transformers-compatible Safetensors shards with a tokenizer and names the governing terms on the model card
Google's release log dates the Gemma 2 27B launch and the current terms list Gemma 2 in their appendix
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind acceptance of Google's restricted Gemma Terms of Use
The model card documents no hosted serving path beyond a link to Vertex Model Garden, and gives no context length, knowledge cutoff, or retirement note
